C. M. L. A. ORDER 3 of 1979
LAWS (CONTINUACE IN FORCE) (TENTH AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary Part I, 31st July 1979]
In pursuance of the Proclamation
of the fifth day of July 1977, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf; the Chief Martial Law Administrator is pleased to make the
following Order :‑‑
1. This Order may be
called the Laws (Continuance in Force) (Tenth Amendment) Order, 1979.
2. In the Laws
(Continuance in Force) Order, 1977 (C. M. L. A. Order No. 1 of 1977), in
Article 2, in clause (1), in the Explanation, in paragraph (a), for the word
"six" the word "seven" shall be substituted.
